name: Luke Laverton
headline: Senior Technical Specialist at M&G | SailPoint IIQ SME
about: Senior IIQ Engineer with over 8 years of hands-on experience in IIQ and over a decade in Identity and Access Management. Expert in designing custom workflows, complex connectors, and automated processes. Proven track record of mentoring teams and delivering scalable, secure IAM solutions in high-stakes financial environments.

certifications.name: IdentityIQ Implementation: Rules, Scripts, and API v8.0
IdentityIQ Implementation and Administration: Essentials v8.1 (with Rapid Setup)
Identity in Administration: Lifecycle Manager Track 7.0

projects.name: Founded the SailPoint Engineering Function
projects.desc: Established the operating model, engineering standards and annual roadmap from scratch. Presented at the M&G Technology All-Hands to 150+ attendees including Director level.

projects.name: Native Change Detection Framework
projects.desc: Custom entry-point routing so out-of-band changes are handled per application instead of firing every workflow for every event, including flagging PIM role assignments made outside the approved process.

projects.name: AD Group & SailPoint Role Creation Workflow
projects.desc: Self-service role and group provisioning with dynamic wizard forms, multi-domain support, and staged approval. Replaced a manual process spanning two teams, saving over 350 hours of effort a year.

projects.name: Toxic Access / SoD Programme
projects.desc: End-to-end segregation of duties, automated violation remediation, and per-policy preventative controls, built with PwC.

projects.name: SQL-Based Reporting Framework
projects.desc: A BeanShell/SQL rule library that replaced a PowerShell reporting process, bypassing IIQ's UI limitations to automate delivery of complex reports to specific workgroups.

projects.name: CyberArk Credential Segregation
projects.desc: Tokenised 100 credential sources to resolve against 3 environment-specific safes, reducing non-production exposure to production credentials.

projects.name: Notable Connector Work
projects.desc: Direct SailPoint connectors over quicker SCIM alternatives where full lifecycle control mattered (Snowflake); a Kyriba integration built around a read-before-write pattern for a PUT-only API; and an extension to the Entra connector to support permanent PIM role assignment.

projects.name: Legacy UAdmin Tool Replacement
projects.desc: Replaced a 1990s in-house identity admin tool covering AD, Oracle and network drive provisioning, with no capability gaps.
